question: Where should the name people see change to VerOS NT, and which license notices have to stay?
allowedInputs: The dialog, boot-menu, command-help, and theme strings already in this tree
ntoskrnl/inbv/resources/logo.bmp, the 16-color boot logo the boot video driver draws
website/VerOS NT Logo.svg, the Inkscape mark used for the replacement artwork
sdk/include/reactos/version.rc and sdk/include/psdk/ntverp.h, which keep the ReactOS Project copyright and trademark lines
The user instruction to update branding across the OS and leave license notices

cursor.prompt: I want you to update the branding across the entire OS to VerOS NT. Just leave any license notices for now.

measuredEffect.metric: English setup welcome title in base/setup/reactos/lang/en-US.rc
measuredEffect.before: Welcome to the ReactOS Setup Wizard
measuredEffect.after: Welcome to the VerOS NT Setup Wizard
measuredEffect.note: Copyright lines, the ReactOS Project company name, the ReactOS trademark sentence, and boot identifiers such as ReactOSSetup were left unchanged. The running boot CD still shows the previous banner until it is rebuilt.
